name: VNC Server
product: RealVNC Server by RealVNC

evidence.says: RealVNC identifies the 7.19.1 macOS Server package as VNC-Server-7.19.1-MacOSX-universal.pkg.
The version-specific release notes record November 2026 as the release month.
Inspection of the official, checksum-matched 7.19.1 package found a universal x86_64 and arm64 vncserver_service executable in RealVNC Server.app with the exact bundle com.realvnc.vncserver_service.

notes: The current 7.x standalone Server keeps the scanned bundle ID. Inspection of the separate Connect 8.6.2 package found a different main bundle and no vncserver_service app.

name: Rename My TV Series
product: Rename My TV Series 2 by Tweaking4All

evidence.says: The developer identifies macOS 2.3.12 as a universal Apple Silicon ARM and Intel 64-bit binary and dates it September 28, 2025.
The product page lists 2.3.12 as the regular Mac download and 2.3.16 as a separate universal beta.

notes: 2.3.16 is an official macOS beta dated 2026-11-21.

name: TouchPortal
product: Touch Portal Host & Editor (Touch Portal)

evidence.says: The vendor publishes a dedicated ARM macOS download for Touch Portal Host & Editor 4.7 Build 2 and lists the matching historical 2.3 Build 10 and 3.1 release family.

notes: The historical scan used a generic Java launcher bundle ID. This is the desktop host and editor.

name: Bootstrap Studio
product: Bootstrap Studio (Zine EOOD)

evidence.says: The vendor dates Bootstrap Studio 9.0.1 to October 23, 2026.
The pinned cask points to the vendor’s versioned 9.0.1 macOS arm64 and x64 DMGs and identifies the app as Bootstrap Studio.

name: Gramps
product: Gramps desktop genealogy software (Gramps Project)

evidence.says: The project’s stable 6.0.8 release dated April 9, 2026 lists Gramps-Arm-6.0.8-1.dmg and a separate Intel DMG.
The official repository’s release API identifies 6.0.8 as the latest stable release and lists the ARM Mac asset.

name: Platypus
product: Platypus (Sveinbjorn Thordarson)

evidence.says: The developer identifies 5.5.0 as the current release and says the main application is a 64-bit Intel/ARM universal binary.

notes: The developer lists macOS 11 as the minimum for this release.

name: ExifCleaner
product: ExifCleaner by szTheory

evidence.says: The official release provides ExifCleaner-4.8.0-arm64.dmg specifically for Apple Silicon and lists a separate Intel image.
GitHub's release metadata identifies 4.8.0 as the latest release and dates its publication to November 10, 2026.

notes: The Homebrew hint is older than the upstream release, and upstream documents that its builds are unsigned.

name: Neon
product: Neon Wallet 2 from City of Zion

evidence.says: City of Zion's tagged source defines com.electron.neon as the application ID in version 2.14.2, matching the original scan.
The official 2.25.1 release lists separate arm64 and x64 macOS images and supplies a checksum for the arm64 image.
The project API labels 2.25.1 the latest Neon Wallet 2 release and records publication on May 9, 2025.

notes: The claim covers the City of Zion Neon Wallet 2 release line.

name: VOCALOID5 Editor
product: VOCALOID5 Editor (Yamaha Corporation)

evidence.says: Yamaha lists the VOCALOID5 Standard and Premium editions as discontinued products.
Yamaha’s 5.7.2 release announcement confirms Apple Silicon compatibility and specifies Rosetta for AU use in Logic Pro and GarageBand.
Yamaha schedules the end of VOCALOID5 Editor customer inquiries for March 31, 2027 and product activation for March 31, 2028.

limitation: Yamaha’s Rosetta instruction applies to the AU plug-in, so the architecture of the final standalone Editor executable remains unverified.
notes: Yamaha still posts the 5.7.2 updater for existing users.

name: Red Giant Launcher
product: Red Giant Launcher bundled with the Shooter Suite 13.1.8 installer (Red Giant)

evidence.says: Maxon documents separate original installers for legacy Red Giant-era products.
The submitted bundle’s Info.plist identifies Red Giant Launcher version 1.0 with ShooterSuite-13.1.8_master_mac_b421.mpkg as its installer payload.

limitation: The original installer executable was unavailable for inspection.
notes: The scan filename identifies the Shooter Suite installer and 1.0 is its launcher bundle version. Keep it distinct from the Red Giant Application Manager and the individual Shooter Suite products.

name: Soundminer v5Pro
product: Soundminer V5 Pro (Soundminer Inc.)

evidence.says: Soundminer calls V5Pro Intel-only, recommends v774 for Monterey, and confirms that the V5 line works on M1 hardware through emulation.
The vendor documentation identifies V5 Pro as the 64-bit sound-library application and distinguishes it from V5 Standard.

limitation: The vendor lists macOS Monterey as the last supported OS for V5 Pro and did not establish compatibility on later macOS versions.
notes: The Apple Silicon-native successor is a separate major version.

name: USB2MIDIDebug
product: Unidentified openFrameworks bundle named USB2MIDIDebug

evidence.says: The directory shows USB2MIDIDebug and USB2MIDI as distinct scan listings.
The submitted bundle metadata names its executable USB2MIDIDebug and uses icon-debug.icns.

limitation: No identifiable public standalone release or publisher could be tied to this bundle.
notes: The bundle reports internal build 1.0 without a release version. The nearby USB2MIDI listing cannot establish compatibility for this build.

name: POD Go Edit
product: POD Go Edit (Line 6)

evidence.says: Line 6 lists 2.50, released January 21, 2025, as the latest macOS build of the editor.
A Mac mini M4 owner reports opening POD Go Edit and receiving the Intel app warning from macOS.
A separate user report identifies the macOS 2.50 release specifically as Intel.

limitation: The M4 report omits its build number, and the official 2.50 download requires a Line 6 login for independent binary inspection.

name: USB_MIDI
product: Unidentified openFrameworks bundle named USB_MIDI

evidence.says: The directory lists USB_MIDI and USB_MIDI2 as distinct scan entries.
The submitted bundle metadata identifies the USB_MIDI executable and records internal build 1.0 without a release version.

limitation: No identifiable public standalone release or publisher could be tied to the generic name and bundle identifier.
notes: The separately scanned USB_MIDI2 bundle cannot establish compatibility for USB_MIDI.

name: USB_MIDI2Debug
product: Unidentified openFrameworks bundle named USB_MIDI2Debug

evidence.says: The directory lists USB_MIDI2Debug separately from USB_MIDI2.
The submitted bundle metadata names its executable USB_MIDI2Debug and uses icon-debug.icns.

limitation: No identifiable public standalone release or publisher could be tied to this bundle.
notes: The bundle reports internal build 1.0 without a release version. USB_MIDI2 has its own listing.

name: Enjoyable
product: Enjoyable (Joe Wreschnig / Yukkuri Games)

evidence.says: The developer’s project page continues to distribute Enjoyable 1.2 as the official release.
Inspection of Enjoyable.app/Contents/MacOS/Enjoyable found a single x86_64 Mach-O, and Info.plist identifies com.yukkurigames.Enjoyable version 1.2, build 650.
Homebrew marks the upstream project unmaintained and identifies the same 1.2 ZIP as its distribution.

limitation: Rosetta operation was not tested for the original Intel-only release.
notes: The original ZIP remains available from Yukkuri Games. Apple Silicon forks are separately maintained.

name: ABAPDevelopmentTools
product: ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse (SAP SE)

evidence.says: SAP publishes current ABAP Development Tools through Eclipse software update sites.
The SAP installation guide requires an Eclipse installation and describes installing ADT as SAP components within it.
The submitted 3.29.200 bundle’s Info.plist identifies its Mac executable as an Eclipse 4.24 distribution.

limitation: The architecture of any current separately bundled SAP ADT launcher remained unverified.
notes: Current ADT runs within Eclipse. The launcher architecture of a bundled Eclipse distribution is specific to that distribution.

name: PA-InstallationManager
product: Plugin Alliance Installation Manager

evidence.says: Plugin Alliance distributes the Mac 1.4.0 ZIP containing PA-InstallationManager-v1.4.0.dmg, whose PA-InstallationManager.app/Contents/MacOS/PA-InstallationManager executable was inspected and contains arm64 and x86_64 slices.
Plugin Alliance documents the standalone manager's plugin download and installation functions and lists Intel and Apple Silicon Mac support.

notes: The inspected app matches the submitted bundle ID and reports 1.4 internally while the vendor package is labeled 1.4.0.

name: Airy
product: Airy for Mac, the Eltima/Airy Team YouTube downloader

evidence.says: The official download's Airy.app/Contents/MacOS/Airy executable was inspected and is x86_64-only, with bundle com.eltima.Airy version 3.29.2 build 400.
The vendor lists 3.29.2 build 400 as its latest Mac release and dates it April 25, 2024.
Homebrew documents that Airy 3.29.2 is built for Intel macOS and requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The vendor warns that recent YouTube changes can limit download functionality.

name: mount
product: User-created NAS-Mount workflow exported as an Apple Automator application

evidence.says: The original plist names Application Stub as the executable, AutomatorApplet as the icon, and Automator workflow file as the document type, and the scan is titled NAS-Mount iMacPro 2021.2.

notes: The recorded version belongs to the exported workflow wrapper.

name: ABIC
product: Advanced Batch Image Converter (ABIC) by Roman Hiestand

evidence.says: The project homepage identifies ABIC as Advanced Batch Image Converter, links its downloads and gives Hiestand's project contact.
The official 1.2.2 release directory dates the Mac DMG to April 30, 2015 and identifies its two slices as 32-bit and 64-bit Intel.

limitation: No source verifies that the 64-bit Intel slice and its dependencies run on Apple Silicon under Rosetta 2.
notes: The project's 2015 use of universal refers to two Intel slices.

name: Helium
product: Helium floating browser by Jaden Geller

evidence.says: Geller's official repository identifies the floating browser project and shows that its owner archived it on February 6, 2022.
CoreCode's exact-bundle record dates the Intel-only Mac App Store 2.0 build to November 10, 2015 and records the Store delisting.
Apple's current US Store lookup returns zero results for this exact Mac bundle ID.

limitation: The final Store build's Intel classification comes from bundle-indexed third-party metadata.
notes: Geller's still-accessible GitHub release archive ends at 1.9, and neither Homebrew hint matches this product.

name: SVP 4 Mac
product: SVP 4 Mac (SVP Manager) from the SmoothVideo Project

evidence.says: The current cask identifies the official 4.7.325-1 Mac image as Intel-only and explicitly requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
The vendor dates the 4.7.325 Manager release to September 27, 2026 and describes its macOS 27 support.
An M1 user describes running SVP and shows an x86_64 SVP Manager crash involving Rosetta.

limitation: The vendor dates Manager 4.7.325 but does not give a separate date for the 4.7.325-1 Mac image, and the Rosetta user report is for an earlier build.
notes: The vendor separately documents native ARM player and plugin support, which does not establish the architecture of SVP Manager.

name: PixInsight
product: PixInsight (Pleiades Astrophoto)

evidence.says: Pleiades Astrophoto explicitly says PixInsight for macOS is distributed as a native ARM64 app alongside an Intel x64 build.
The developer announced the 1.9.6 Lockhart macOS release on October 30, 2026.
The vendor’s benchmark site records PixInsight Core 1.9.6 arm64 running on a macOS Apple M5 Ultra on November 23, 2026.
The developer announced 1.9.6 build 1719 on November 20, 2026 with macOS installers for licensed users and Metal support on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The public benchmark reports 1.9.6 without a build number, and the official installer requires a license login for binary inspection.
notes: The current 1.9.6 release line is native. The vendor’s latest announced maintenance build is 1719.

name: Webcam Settings
product: Webcam Settings by Mactaris (Liang-Hsin Chen)

evidence.says: The Mac App Store identifies Mactaris and lists 3.0, released October 30, 2019, as the latest version.
Rosetta Check reports the exact com.mactaris.Webcam-Settings bundle at version 3.0 as Intel-only in submitted Mac inventory.
Macworld reports that the Mac App Store Webcam Settings works on Apple Silicon Macs using Rosetta on macOS Big Sur.

limitation: The runtime report dates to Big Sur, and camera controls can vary by device.

name: Amanote
product: Amanote desktop note-taking application by Amaplex

evidence.says: Amanote's download page offers a macOS desktop installer along with the web version.
Amanote's macOS updater feed reports release 4.1.6 dated September 23, 2024 and provides package sizes without stating their architecture.

limitation: The vendor does not state whether 4.1.6 is Intel or ARM, and both official Mac archives are larger than the inspection limit.

name: Image Vectorizer
product: Image Vectorizer by Icosasoft Software, originally listed under Midwinter Duncan Grant

evidence.says: The developer explicitly states that Image Vectorizer 1.7 runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
Apple's Store metadata matches the exact original bundle ID and records version 1.7 on November 19, 2026 under Icosasoft Software.

notes: The App Store seller changed, with the original Midwinter bundle ID preserved.

name: ALZip
product: ALZip for Mac by ESTsoft

evidence.says: ESTsoft's historical notice confirms that its Mac edition of ALZip was distributed via the Mac App Store.
The current official ALZip download page covers Windows and Linux, with no Mac edition offered.
Apple's Korean Store lookup returns zero results for the original Mac bundle ID.
The archived exact-bundle scan records ALZip 1.40 with Intel-family architecture entries and no ARM entry.

limitation: No vendor end-of-life notice or release date for 1.40 was found, and 1.40 is the last Mac release located.
notes: The last located Mac release was Intel-only and current ALZip releases for other platforms do not apply.

name: DanteFirmwareUpdateManager
product: Dante Firmware Update Manager by Audinate

evidence.says: Audinate's standalone Firmware Update Manager manual names version 3.10.6 and lists its supported legacy macOS releases.
Dante hardware manufacturer KLANG labels this Audinate tool legacy and directs users to its replacement, Dante Updater.
Audinate's current firmware workflow uses Dante Updater through Dante Controller.

limitation: The final standalone Mac executable's architecture and release date were not independently confirmed.
notes: 3.10.6 is the latest standalone release documented by Audinate that was located.

name: LiveIPC
product: LiveIPC desktop client for Wansview cameras (Shanghai Fukong Hualong Microsystem Technology)

evidence.says: The submitted macOS 1.3.0 bundle metadata records fkhl.LiveIPC and the developer’s Chinese company name.
Wansview’s B Series user manual identifies LiveIPC.dmg as the desktop Mac camera client supplied on CD.
Wansview distributor Calytel lists a later LiveIPC 1.4.0 Mac package for its cameras without specifying architecture.

limitation: A current upstream distribution or architecture statement for LiveIPC 1.4.0 could not be verified, and the reseller download did not yield a usable installer.
notes: The evidence concerns the original Mac camera client.

name: Epson Low Ink Reminder
product: Epson Low Ink Reminder utility by Seiko Epson

evidence.says: Epson supplies a separate Low Ink Reminder 1.7.5 package dated September 30, 2025 and lists macOS versions up to Tahoe.
Rosetta Check lists com.epson.Epson_Low_Ink_Reminder 1.7.5 as Intel-only based on Mac inventory reports.

limitation: The vendor's download was inaccessible to inspection, and its OS support table and the Mac installation reports do not demonstrate a successful Rosetta launch.
notes: Epson also delivers this utility in printer software bundles.

name: VOX Universal
product: VOX Universal Beta cross-platform music player by Coppertino

evidence.says: The vendor distributes its Mac beta here, and the linked VOX Universal.dmg contains an x86_64-only VOX Universal.app/Contents/MacOS/VOX Universal executable matching the submitted bundle ID.
The first-party download script selects the Mac DMG under release path 0.9.37, matching the inspected app's build string.
VOX support identifies VOX Universal Beta and VOX Music Player for macOS as distinct applications.

limitation: Rosetta operation for the current beta build and an official release date were not verified.
notes: The plist short version is 0.9 and the build is 0.9.37; Universal refers to the cross-platform product name.

name: IGdm
product: IG:dm open-source Instagram messenger by Ifedapo Olarewaju and IGdm Apps

evidence.says: The maintainer marks v3.0.4 as latest and publishes the original IGdm Mac artifacts alongside its release notes.
GitHub's first-party metadata records the April 18, 2022 publication date and Mac DMG and ZIP assets.
Homebrew associates the exact original bundle ID with the maintainer's v3.0.4 DMG and sets the Rosetta-required caveat.
Homebrew states that 3.0.4 is Intel-only and requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: Homebrew disables this cask over a Gatekeeper failure, and current Instagram sign-in was not verified.
notes: The separate IGdm Pro downloads do not establish the architecture of this original open-source bundle.

name: Mahjong Solitaire Epic
product: Mahjong Solitaire Epic for Mac by Kristanix Games

evidence.says: Apple's official lookup ties Mac App Store item 687208243 to the original bundle ID and dates version 3.0.1 to October 27, 2026.
Desktop Insights reports detecting arm64 and x86_64 in the shipped 3.0.1 app and links that scan to the same App Store item 687208243.

limitation: Architecture was verified against a published third-party inspection of the shipped Mac build.
notes: This covers the separate Mac App Store listing from Kristanix.

name: Rosetta Stone
product: Rosetta Stone Classic-2024 for Mac by Rosetta Stone

evidence.says: Apple's Store lookup matches the exact Catalyst bundle to the Mac listing 1476088902 and dates version 9.2.6 to October 30, 2026.
Desktop Insights reports detecting arm64 and x86_64 in the shipped 9.2.6 app and links that scan to the same App Store item 1476088902.
Rosetta Stone identifies Classic as its Mac App Store app and specifies macOS 13.0 or later.

limitation: Architecture was verified against a published third-party inspection of the shipped Mac build.
notes: The original Learn Languages Catalyst listing continues under the Classic-2024 name.

name: X-DAP Link
product: X-DAP Link for Mac (Onkyo & Pioneer Innovations Corporation)

evidence.says: Pioneer’s historical device support page lists X-DAP Link 1.0.0 as a Mac download dated July 13, 2016.
Onkyo’s DP-X1A manual identifies X-DAP Link.app as its Mac utility for transferring music to the player.
The prior scan ties the 1.0.0.1606131 bundle to com.onkyo.xdaplink and reports only an Intel architecture.

limitation: The official archive link returned 404 and the Mac updater host no longer resolves, so current distribution and the final Mac build could not be verified.
notes: The recorded version is the documented historical Mac release. Later versions cited by the DP-S1 manual use a Windows installer.

name: FM TiNES 2
product: FM TiNES 2 Dedicated standalone electric-piano instrument by Gospel Musicians

evidence.says: Gospel Musicians advertises native M1 sound support, demonstrates the Pure Synth plugin in Logic, and lists a standalone Dedicated format without an exact Mac standalone build number.
The vendor's public download-help page provides activation and content instructions without a public versioned Mac application archive.

limitation: The architecture of a specific current com.gospelmusicians.FMTiNES2 standalone build remains unverified.
notes: The product is also offered as an expansion for the separate Pure Synth player.

name: Logi Bolt
product: Logitech Logi Bolt standalone receiver-pairing app

evidence.says: Logitech dates the last listed Mac build 1.2.6024 to January 5, 2022, and inspection of its legacy ZIP and nested LogiBolt.pkg found an x86_64-only Logi Bolt.app/Contents/MacOS/Logi Bolt executable.
Logitech says it moved the standalone app's features into Logi Options+ and directs users to install the successor for connecting and customizing devices.

notes: The final standalone build was Intel-only and remains available as a legacy download.

name: Loupe Browser 6
product: Loupe Browser by 10x Genomics

evidence.says: 10x Genomics lists 6.3.0 in the same Loupe Browser release history and records the separate native arm64 build of 9.1.0 on June 22, 2026.
The current vendor support page identifies v9.1 as the latest Loupe Browser release.

limitation: The claim covers the current release and the architecture of the last 6.x Mac build remains unverified.
notes: The submitted 6.3.0 build carries a version-specific name and bundle ID, so rename the listing to Loupe Browser when updating it to the continuous product's current release.

name: Harmony Desktop
product: Logitech Harmony Desktop for non-hub Harmony remotes

evidence.says: The current linked HarmonyDesktop.dmg contains Harmony Desktop.pkg, and inspection found an x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/Harmony Desktop executable and the matching com.logitech.myharmony plist at version 1.0.303.
Logitech identifies Harmony Desktop as the 64-bit Mac client for non-hub remotes and distinguishes it from the legacy MyHarmony software.
A Harmony 950 owner reports using Harmony Desktop 1.0.303 successfully on Tahoe but does not identify the Mac processor.

limitation: An explicit Apple Silicon or Rosetta runtime report for this client and the official release date were not verified.
notes: The May 2025 shutdown notice on the download page concerns the separate Logitech Harmony Remote Software.
